# Diogo N. Moura: full profile and Q&A

> Diogo N. Moura is a Porto-based strategy operator who helps scale-up founders turn ambiguous problems into prioritised decisions, and decisions into operating outcomes. He has twelve years across management consulting (Accenture, EY) and corporate leadership, and is currently Head of Corporate Strategy & Growth and an Executive Board member at Mercedes-Benz.io Portugal.

Website: https://diogonmoura.com
Short summary: https://diogonmoura.com/llms.txt
Last updated: 2026-11-23

## Who is Diogo N. Moura?

Diogo N. Moura (also written Diogo Moura) is a strategy executive based in Porto, Portugal. He trained as a mechanical engineer at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Porto, worked as a consultant at Accenture (2015 to 2017) and EY (2017 to 2021) across Europe and APAC, and joined Mercedes-Benz.io, where he is Head of Corporate Strategy & Growth and sits on the Executive Board. Alongside that role he takes a small number of fractional, advisory or short engagements with scale-up founders.

## What does Diogo N. Moura do for scale-up founders?

Diogo N. Moura works in four areas, and most engagements combine two of them.

Strategic clarity: he frames an ambiguous problem sharply enough that a small group of busy people can decide it in a room, picks the two or three bets that matter and kills the rest. The deliverable is a decision, not a 60-slide deck.

AI strategy: he designs the operating model and governance for AI adoption. He designed an internal AI strategy from scratch, covering operating model, governance framework and adoption roadmap.

Programme rescue: when a programme has gone off-track and the team has lost trust, he restabilises governance, rebuilds stakeholder confidence and ships to production.

Operating model and cost: he redesigns roles, decision rights, rituals and the cost base underneath them.

## Who is Diogo N. Moura a good fit for?

Diogo N. Moura is a good fit for scale-up founders facing a strategic decision where getting it wrong costs months of runway: market entry, an AI rollout, a programme that is slipping, or a cost base that is drifting. He does not target corporate boards or enterprise procurement processes.

## How does an engagement with Diogo N. Moura work?

Engagements are fractional, advisory or short and scoped. Diogo N. Moura takes a small number of clients at a time, works from Porto with founders anywhere in the world, and works in English or Portuguese (Spanish at a basic level). Success is measured by a decision that is running in the operating model.

## What has Diogo N. Moura delivered?

- 2026, corporate: designed an internal AI strategy, including operating model, governance framework and adoption roadmap.
- 2025 to present, corporate: recovered a critical Data Warehouse programme that had gone off-track and shipped it to production.
- 2024 to present, corporate: built a workforce plan for international scaling across resource allocation and performance.
- 2023, corporate: drove a cost transformation that delivered 55% in annual savings through partnership renegotiation, resource optimisation and rightsizing.
- 2021, corporate: stood up an office from zero, with 20% headcount growth in its first year, from board approval through hiring, governance and first-year operation.
- 2020, consulting: architected a 10-year technology and innovation roadmap for a major utility.
- 2018, consulting: led a PMO for a large-scale software implementation with more than 15 concurrent initiatives in logistics and transportation.
- 2017, consulting: led human-capital transformation across more than 25 countries and 8-country APAC integration teams, affecting more than 3,000 employees.

## What is Diogo N. Moura's education?

- Integrated Master in Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Porto (2009 to 2014).
- Post-graduation in Applied Management with Distinction, NOVA School of Business and Economics (2018 to 2019).
- Certificate in Executive Presence and Influence, INSEAD (2022 to 2023).
- McKinsey Forward Program (2024).

## How do I contact Diogo N. Moura?

Email contact@diogonmoura.com or message him on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/diogonmoura. A short paragraph describing the decision you are facing is enough to start.
